[name="仇白"]越来越热了……
[name="仇白"]昨晚有人行刺魏彦吾，把玉门军营弄得桃花乱飞，泥臭熏天。那个刺客，应该也是你。
[name="仇白"]所到之处，气候如此反常，这是源石技艺，还是别的什么把戏？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_786_1#1$2")]
[name="山海众首领"]……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_297_1#6$1")]
[name="左乐"]截杀信使，抢夺天灾数据未果，便接连行刺朝廷要员。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_297_1#3$1")]
[CameraShake(duration=0.3, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="左乐"]山海众，究竟视玉门为何物？！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_786_1#1$2")]
[name="山海众首领"]一座目的地错了的城而已。
[name="山海众首领"]目的地错了，就不该再往前走了。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_297_1#6$1")]
[name="左乐"]你们知道玉门归国的目的……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_786_1#1$2")]
[name="山海众首领"]不难猜。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_297_1#6$1")]
[name="左乐"]父亲命我三日内办成三件事，追回宗师佩剑，抓捕刺客，找出潜藏在城内的山海众。
[name="左乐"]想不到，都落在这小小的铸剑坊里。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_786_1#1$2")]
[name="山海众首领"]恐怕你一件都办不成。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_297_1#6$1",focus = "n",duration=0.3)]
[charslot(slot = "r",action="zoom", poszoom = "0.5,0.5",scale=0.95,duration = 0)]
[charslot(slot = "r",posfrom = "0,0", posto = "-100,0",duration = 0)]
[Delay(time=0.5)]
[charslot(slot = "l", name="avg_npc_787_1#11$1",focus="l",duration = 0.3)]
[charslot(slot = "l",posfrom = "0,0", posto = "100,0",focus="l",duration = 0.5)]
[Delay(time=0.5)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_787_1#11$1",focus = "l")]
[name="仇白"]往后站，这人武功深不可测，我们不是对手。
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_786_1#1$2")]
[name="山海众首领"]你没那个丰蹄汉子能打，反应倒是比他机灵一点。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_787_1#7$1")]
[name="仇白"]果然是你伤了太合先生。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_786_1#1$2")]
[name="山海众首领"]刚刚那一刀，你躲开了。那下一刀，是躲还是接？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_787_1#7$1")]
[name="仇白"]……
[charslot(slot ="m", afrom = 1, ato = 0,duration = 0.5)]
既不躲，也不接。
那人常跟她说，为了报仇也好，为了安身立命也好，习武，就要有徒步登高的打算。越是力有不逮，越是要坚定心志。
既见仇敌，又见高山，所以自己在他身边待了整整五年。
赢不了的仗，那就但求不输！
[Dialog]
[Delay(time=0.5)]
[Blocker(a=0.5, r=1, g=1, b=1, fadetime=0.05, block=true)]
[charslot(slot = "l",name="avg_npc_787_1#7$1")]
[charslot(slot="l",  posfrom = "-100,0", posto = "100,0",duration =0.5 )]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.1, block=true)]
[charslot(slot = "l", afrom = 1, ato = 0,duration = 0.3)]
[Delay(time=0.1)]
[charslot(slot ="m", name="avg_npc_787_1#3$1", duration = 0.2)]
[playsound(key="$e_skill_skulsrsword",volume=0.7)]
[Effect(name="$e_slash_01_l",x = 100,roz=120,roy=-50,rox=-30,layer = 1)]
[CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[Delay(time=0.2)]
[charslot(slot ="m", afrom = 1, ato = 0,duration = 0.5)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_786_1#1$2")]
[name="山海众首领"]以攻为守？
[name="山海众首领"]也算有点胆识……
[name="山海众首领"]但，你是不是想得太简单了。
[dialog]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_786_1#6$2")]
[Blocker(a=0.5, r=1, g=1, b=1, fadetime=0.05, block=true)]
[charslot(duration=0.2)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.2, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=1, g=1, b=1, fadetime=1, block=false)]
[playsound(key="$swordtsing4",volume=0.7)]
[Effect(name="$e_spark_01_large",x = 170,y=-100,layer = 1)]
[Delay(time=0.2)]
[CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[playsound(key="$swordtsing6",volume=0.7)]
[Effect(name="$e_spark_01_mid",x = -170,y=100,layer = 1)]
[Delay(time=0.2)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.1, block=true)]
[Delay(time=0.2)]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_787_1#7$1")]
[name="仇白"]——
[charslot]
武器相交的那一瞬，她才知道自己的决定有多轻率。
她此刻面对的，竟然是另一座高山。
寒光拂面，鼻尖撞碎了对方刀刃上的水珠，心跳清晰可闻。
如果录武官在场，想必会惊呼仇白复现了演武场上那一招——
俯冲，收势，在撞上死亡的弧光前及时折返，像是江面上险些被浪头打翻的羽兽。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_787_1#2$1")]
[CameraShake(duration=0.3, xstrength=12, ystrength=6, vibrato=15, randomness=20, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="仇白"]（闷哼）
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_786_1#1$2")]
[name="山海众首领"]这一刀，你又躲了。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_787_1#5$1",duration=0.3, focus = "n")]
[charslot(slot = "left",action="zoom", poszoom = "0.5,0.5", scale=0.95,duration = 0)]
[charslot(slot = "left", posfrom = "-50,0", posto = "0,0",duration = 0.5)]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_297_1#6$1",focus = "r",duration=0.3)]
[charslot(slot = "r", posfrom = "50,0", posto = "-250,0",duration = 0.5)]
[Delay(time=0.5)]
[CameraShake(duration=0.3, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_297_1#3$1",focus = "r")]
[name="左乐"]还想逞凶！
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_786_1#1$2")]
[name="山海众首领"]你？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_787_1#3$1")]
[name="仇白"]左乐，避！
[dialog]
[charslot]
[Blocker(a=1, r=1, g=1, b=1, fadetime=1, block=false)]
[playsound(key="$d_avg_katanamagic")]
左乐被仇白拽住衣领急退。
他的视野里，敌人如影随形，挥出了第三刀。整个院子陡然亮了几分。
铸剑坊在三月来到了大暑，热浪升腾，连夜空都被蒸得泛起了白色。
而他们的身后只有一棵老槐，退无可退。
[Dialog]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_4078_bdhkgt_1#1$1")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_296_1#6$1")]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=1.5, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=1.5, block=true)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_4078_bdhkgt_1#7$1",focus="l")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_296_1#6$1",focus="n")]
[name="截云"]……
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_4078_bdhkgt_1#7$1",focus="l")]
[name="截云"]剑。
[Dialog]
[charslot(slot = "l", action="shake", power=10, times=100,random=30, duration=0.5)]
[Delay(time=0.5)]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_296_1#5$1",focus="r")]
[name="杜遥夜"]别乱动！
[name="杜遥夜"]这会儿还想抢剑？你想撞在那女人的刀上啊！
[CameraShake(duration=0.3, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="杜遥夜"]没把孟铁衣的下落告诉我，去送死？个锤子的*尚蜀俚语*！

[name="莫佚"]等……（喘气）咳咳……等一下……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1871_1#9$1")]
[name="莫佚"]*来历不明的粗口*，你跑得也太快了！  
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4121_zuole_1#1$1")]
[name="左乐"]怎么了？不是你说时间紧张，一刻也不能耽误？  
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4121_zuole_1#1$1")]
[name="左乐"]你要是跑不动，把东西给我，我自己去送。  
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1871_1#4$1")]
[name="莫佚"]做你的梦！  
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1871_1#9$1")]
[name="莫佚"]你个呆子，只知道赶路，你就没想过我们赶到了岁陵，又该怎么进去？  
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4121_zuole_1#1$1")]
[name="左乐"]……当然是找把守岁陵的禁军说明情况，请他们放行……  
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1871_1#3$1")]
[name="莫佚"]好好好……那你又准备怎么和禁军解释，你手上的东西是从哪里来的？ 
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4121_zuole_1#3$1")] 
[name="左乐"]或者……再想办法溜进去……  
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1871_1#1$1")]
[name="莫佚"]我真是服了你个呆头蛇——  
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4121_zuole_1#1$1")]
[name="左乐"]那你又有什么办法？  
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1871_1#1$1")]
[name="莫佚"]我们进不了岁陵，当然是找能进岁陵的人，帮我们把东西带进去啊。 
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4121_zuole_1#3$1")] 
[name="左乐"]你是说……  
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4121_zuole_1#4$1")] 
[multiline(name="左乐")]何人——
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4121_zuole_1#5$1")]
[multiline(name="左乐")]出来！
[multiline]
[dialog]
[charslot]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_exsheath", volume=1)]
察觉到一股突如其来的杀意，战斗的本能让左乐立即拔出刀来。 
[dialog] 
[PlaySound(key="$d_gen_walk_n", volume=1)]
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_786_1#1$1",duration=1,isblock=true)] 
[name="睚"]你答应要给我的东西。  
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_786_1#1$1")] 
[name="睚"]交出来。  
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1871_1#13$1")]
[name="莫佚"]……
